operations.name: sessions.summarize
operations.description: AI summary of a brainstorm session (the host's language model; 503 when none is connected).

operations.name: sessions.outline
operations.description: Return a brainstorm session's full node tree as an indented text outline.

operations.name: sessions.get
operations.description: One session as the person sees it: title, topic, counts, and every node with its type (question/answer/idea), parent, depth and canvas x/y.

operations.name: sessions.create
operations.description: Create a session with its root idea node on the canvas, as the New Session dialog does.

topic.description: Topic to explore, max 2000 chars; it becomes the root node's text.

operations.name: sessions.ai-explore
operations.description: The AI Explore dialog: `effort` steps, each one model call adding up to 4 idea nodes under the next branch of a breadth- or depth-first walk, placed on the canvas (the host's language model; 503 when none is connected).

strategy.description: bfs (default): every branch tip before going deeper; dfs: keep drilling into the newest branch.

effort.description: Steps, one model call each: 2, 3 (default) or 5.

start_node_id.description: Node record id to start from; omitted = Auto (the session's branch tips).

operations.name: nodes.add
operations.description: Add a child node under a node, placed on the canvas like the Add node dialog.

operations.name: nodes.edit
operations.description: Change a node's text and/or type, as the node editor's Save does.

operations.name: nodes.expand
operations.description: The Expand button: AI adds up to 3 question children under a node, placed on the canvas (the host's language model; 503 when none is connected).

operations.name: nodes.ai-answer
operations.description: The Answer button: AI answers a question node and adds the answer as a child (the host's language model; 503 when none is connected).

operations.name: nodes.delete
operations.description: Delete a node and all its descendants, as the delete dialog does.
